items.title: Google Adds Cycle-Level Kernel Profiling to XProf
items.blurb: Google has added a Kernel Profiling suite to XProf. This is its open-source profiler for TPU workloads. Now, developers can see cycle-level details in custom Pallas kernels.

items.title: Latest BGP hijack targets hosting software vendor
items.blurb: Guest Post: An analysis of the BGP hijack against Softaculous that enabled an attacker to obtain a fraudulent TLS certificate and distribute a malicious Virtualizor update.

items.title: The GitHub wiki is an anti-pattern
items.blurb: Using the wiki on GitHub makes life more difficult for your users, and you as a maintainer. Use the `/docs` folder and GitHub Pages instead and keep your docs in sync with code

items.title: SAML: A fractal of bad design
items.blurb: SAML, the XML-based authentication protocol that birthed the SSO industry, is fundamentally flawed due to XML complexity, canonicalization issues, enveloped signatures, and design ossification, making it vulnerable to signature wrapping…

items.title: Abandoning Scientific Linux Was a Mistake
items.blurb: CERN's move to Debian for accelerator control systems is a reminder that Scientific Linux was worth more than the small team required to maintain it.
